product_metadata.title: IRIS USA DF-SS CLR 6PK IRIS Small Drop Front Shoe Box, Clear
features: Unique small shoe and accessory storage box
Clear window to view contents; stack multiple units to maximize storage
Drop-front door provides easy access to contents even when stacked
Ventilation holes allow for air circulation and odor prevention
Fits most women’s shoes up to size 10; made in the USA
description: Our shoe storage box has a drop front door so you can easily access your shoes even when units are stacked or on a high shelf. The clear front and sides allow you to see what's inside at a glance. Air can easily circulate throughout each unit with featured ventilation holes. This box is also great for storing, displaying, and organizing any small object in your garage, basement, or bedroom.
